mainEntity.name: How much weight should I gain in the first trimester?

acceptedAnswer.text: The IOM report assumes a small first-trimester gain of about 1.1–4.4 lb (0.5–2 kg). Most of the gain comes in the second and third trimesters.
Carrying two babies needs more weight gain to support their growth. The IOM twin ranges are provisional, and no range was set for underweight women because the evidence was too limited.

mainEntity.name: What if I'm gaining more or less than the range?

acceptedAnswer.text: Weight gain varies week to week. If you're consistently above or below the range, talk to your care team — they can look at your diet, activity and health and suggest changes safely.
